C-RELEASE-CONTROLS-ACTIVATION.Summary: Repair the owner-local GitHub controls activation executor so it mutates both staged rulesets and verifies the active state explicitly.
C-RELEASE-CONTROLS-ACTIVATION.Problem: The activate command computes two disabled-to-active ruleset updates but the reconciler executes mutations only in apply mode, then reports the unapplied plan as success. The documented post-activation check also targets the disabled staging state, so it cannot prove live enforcement.
C-RELEASE-CONTROLS-ACTIVATION.ApprovalBasis: The owner instructed the agent to repair and complete the release pipeline, then asked for live verification after supplying all release-signing secrets on 2026-10-21.

Goals.Goal: Execute and journal activation mutations with the same one-operation-at-a-time read-back used by staged apply.
Provide an explicit read-only active-state check that rejects disabled rulesets.
Add deterministic regression evidence for the disabled-to-active transition.

Constraints.Constraint: Keep the checked-in ruleset definitions disabled so initial rollout remains staged and owner-controlled.
Do not weaken check identities, bypass actors, Environment boundaries, owner recovery, or rollback evidence.
Do not create a release tag, publish a release, or change train admission.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Do not redesign release publication or alter application behavior.
Do not migrate or inspect secret values.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Activate applies exactly the planned main and release-tag ruleset updates, journals both, and converges only after live read-back reports active enforcement.
The active-state check fails while either managed ruleset is disabled and succeeds only when both normalized live rulesets match the active target.
Focused M-046 tests, release governance, GRACE lint/status, and direct GitHub API read-back pass.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Two journaled update-ruleset mutations followed by zero active-state drift and direct API enforcement=active for both managed rulesets.

C-RELEASE-CONTROLS-ACTIVATION.AppliedEvidence: PR #22 merge aa38f35f (d7ff6d8a); both GitHub rulesets verified active via API 2026-10-22.
